title: Token bucket rate limiter
summary: Allow bursts up to N requests but an average of R per second; reject or delay the rest.
approach: Tokens refill continuously at R/s up to capacity N. Each request consumes one token; compute refill lazily from elapsed time.
body: Wrap it in an actor (or `Mutex`) for concurrent callers. Passing `now` in makes it deterministic to test.
Compare with fixed window (bursty at edges) and sliding log (accurate, more memory).
